This one?
What invitation letter?

Welcome, friend, to the Ayar Heroes' Cup. I'm the organizer.
Today's the last day of the competition. If you want to claim the crown, you'll need to defeat our top three warriors back to back.
What is the Ayar Heroes' Cup?
It's a battle for the glory of Ayar! Use fists, weapons, or any other trick in the book to defeat your opponent!
And is Ayar a... person, or...?
My friend, only champions are qualified to ask questions here!
Get on stage! We'll soon see if you have the strength to earn that respect.
Careful, lil' one. You wouldn't want me to snap your arm like a twig!
I know who you are, friend, but that doesn't mean I'll go easy on you.
Yeah. Truth be told, we were hoping you'd go easy on us...
